_comment: Claude Desktop. macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json — Windows: %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json. Remove the _comment keys before use.

filesystem._comment: The original entry was command 'npx' with the args after '--'. Everything after '--' is untouched.

github._comment: Environment variables still go to the wrapped server, not to mcp-audit.

with-policy._comment: A named config file, so this server gets its own deny rules and its own audit log.

absolute-path-example._comment: GUI apps do not inherit your shell PATH. If the client cannot find mcp-audit, use the full path.
